text: The following is a conversation with Javier Malay, the president of Argentina. He is a libertarian, anarcho -capitalist, and economist. who campaigned with a chainsaw. that symbolized his promise to slash the corrupt bureaucracy of the state. He stepped into the presidency one year ago. with a country on the brink of hyperinflation, deepened debt, and suffering. from mass unemployment and poverty.
